pull_request.title: Calorimeter: compare tiled ECAL with continuous sector silicon
pull_request.head: codex/ecal10k-untiled-control
pull_request.body:
The original tiled ECAL sample has broad angular raw-response distributions. This adds a deliberately unbuildable control with continuous 0.5 mm sensitive silicon across each existing sector carrier face and reruns the exact same 10,000 electron primary records with 12 DDSim workers, seeds and physics settings. Follow-up to #134; no production detector or design-approval change.

The paired overlays show |eta| widths falling from 27.95–55.78% to 9.41–16.46%; folded-phi interior bins from 22.59–25.32% to 3.69–4.10%; and seam-adjacent bins from 110.31/110.09% to 27.22/27.26%. All twenty direct tiled-minus-continuous 95% paired-bootstrap intervals are positive. Mean response and all underlying angular populations accompany the widths; zero responses remain included (42 tiled, 37 continuous). The observable is sample SD(R)/mean(R), R = raw silicon deposit / true energy, rather than intrinsic fixed-energy reconstructed resolution.

The XML-only control reuses unchanged native factories and audit libraries, retains inherited sector seams, layer planes, absorber and other passive material, and explicitly subtracts support intersections at silicon planes. It adds 2,475.64 kg of silicon and removes 447.43 kg of aluminium. Thus the result measures this coverage/material counterfactual, including guards, module gaps and service margins together; it does not define a separable electronics or tiling variance term.

Validation: 18 geometry/statistical controls; 2,304 native sheets and unique volume IDs; 3,136 wide-address checks; zero native overlaps/extrusions at 1e-5 mm; 24-event/12-worker pilot; full 10,000-primary and 10,006,736-hit readback; exact primary pairing and unchanged original twenty moments; 5,000 paired whole-event bootstrap replicas with finite symmetric positive-definite 40-width and 20-difference covariance; visual plot inspection; separate PhysVal source/result assessments; project, inventory, session/interaction/token validators and token-site build. Full transport took 1514.572 s, used 2.302 GiB peak RSS and wrote 13.146 GB. About 385 GiB remains free; no sample reduction was needed.

Only recipes, figures, compact binwise evidence and curated records are published. Raw ROOT, exact primary/event ledgers, full per-part geometry ledger and bulky logs remain local and ignored. No engineering acceptance or intrinsic-resolution claim. Exact task token counters are unavailable.

![Tiled versus continuous silicon response widths](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/9ec0abf613f87c13492c900d0e7f573329d6f27a/docs/validation/ecal10k-untiled/results/resolution-overlay.png)

|---|---:|---:|
| Absolute eta bins | 28–56% | 9–16% |
| Folded phi interior | 23–25% | 3.7–4.1% |
| Near sector seams | ≈110% | ≈27% |

The width is sample SD(R)/mean(R), with R = silicon energy / true primary energy. Bars show 95% paired whole-event bootstrap intervals. The control fills module, guard and service gaps and requires support cuts; inherited sector seams remain. This is a deliberately unbuildable coverage/material control.

- [Ten folded-phi response distributions](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/9ec0abf613f87c13492c900d0e7f573329d6f27a/docs/validation/ecal10k-untiled/results/response-distributions-folded_phi.svg)

events.text: Calibration and staggered-layout suggestions from ECAL control — see the canonical narrative for outcomes and checks.

The user said: “Please go ahead with these tests.” This follows the proposed
local-position calibration and independent module-phase tests in PR135. The
bounded implementation uses identical retained 10,000 electron inputs and
12 DDSim workers, with disk planning and a live guard. Starting revision:
`3af5538faf884d0abce98b0956c0e6d4f45d4527`; clean dedicated branch
`codex/ecal-calibration-staggering-tests`. Earlier samples remain unchanged.
The repository is the canonical record. This is an isolated PROTOTYPE under
DES-030/DES-031; no human sign-off or production integration is inferred.

The coordinator applied `nodd-coordinate`, `nodd-design-evidence`,
`nodd-review-validation` and the local ACTS Spack skill. Changed setup/lock
fingerprints were disclosed before dependent work; the native runtime doctor
passed. Existing dependencies were reused without modifying shared installs.

events.text:
The physical four-phase board layout was frozen before response inspection.
Barrel narrow edge boards preserve envelopes/ASIC capacity; short slabs use a
24 mm quarter-phase to preserve rows/clearance. All area/material changes are
explicit. Native construction/IDs/electrodes/zero-overlap checks, 24-event pilot,
full 10k transport and all saved-primary/hit/12-worker audits pass. The original
sector seams remain. Dense mask screening is geometry only.

The calibration protocol freezes observable-only features, five outer/three
inner ID folds, training-only preprocessing, ridge candidates and gain bounds.
Separate `Model.infer(features, signal)` returns energy without truth inputs;
held-out truth changes leave inferred energy unchanged. No held-out retuning.
The first baseline fit improves global CV from 43.09% to 34.43%, while retaining
mean Ecal/Etrue=0.9136 and 8.99% clipping. This scale bias is a reported limitation,
not removed by an evaluation-derived correction. Final paired analysis follows.
